trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate) in all regions. I identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (status: open, on-call paged) documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. It also notes that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until its failure is root-caused.
